name: 図形の比率を数で入力
prompt:
Edit the first image while preserving its successful pure-white surfaces, forest-green diagram and actions, neutral text, clean key outlines, typography and overall composition. Use the second image as the precise 390 × 760 geometry and copy authority. Correct only the following:

- Set the answer in the input field to the exact full-width string “3：3” with no spaces and no ASCII colon. The bottom-left keypad key must display the exact full-width “：”. The hint button must display the exact Japanese full-width “？” glyph.
- Align elements to the second image’s native coordinates: prompt x=16/y=8; shape rows y=118, 160, 202; ratio field x=16/y=320; hint and submit controls y=404; keypad begins y=466; key rows begin y=480, 546, 612, 678. Each key remains 114×54 with 66 px between row starts. Keep the fourth row’s bottom at y=732 with a 28 px bottom margin. Do not compress the row spacing.
- Keep all white surfaces pure white #FFFFFF. Keep squares white with forest-green #1F6444 outlines and triangles flat solid #1F6444. Keep the hint control white with a neutral outline and slate #526173 “？” glyph. Keep the button and selected colon key flat solid #1F6444 with white labels. No gradients, tints, mint fills, paper texture, shadows or glow.

Preserve the current content exactly: “図形の数の比率を答えてください”; three squares and three triangles; “3：3”; “？”; “答えを確認する”; keypad labels in order 1,2,3 / 4,5,6 / 7,8,9 / ：,0,消す. Use Meiryo and the same sizes and weights as the second image. Keep the original centered shape spacing and control geometry. No extra text, app chrome, correctness feedback or visual decoration. The final output is one 390 × 760 component on a uniform white canvas.
reviewNotes: White/neutral surfaces remain clean and all keys visible. One correction did not fix ASCII “3 : 3” / “?” or the compressed vertical keypad spacing; preserve as pending after the correction limit.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
